newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union traces origins to 18th century.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union traces origins to 18th century.

text.p: The Norwich Union, which on Wednesday said it will float on the stock market, is one of the largest insurance groups in Britain and next year will celebrate its 200th anniversary.

Aside from its life insurance and pensions business, Norwich Union also has a large general insurance business, which under its mutually-owned society structure is owned by the life insurance fund. It also has overseas subsidiaries
Flotation as Norwich Union Plc will enable the general insurance business to be transferred out of the life fund.
The group originated in 1797 as Norwich Union Fire Insurance Ltd, founded by Thomas Bagnold, a City of London wine merchant.
Bagnold spotted a gap in the market when he moved to Norwich as he found no insurance was available against highwaymen who robbed travellers in the area.

The Norwich Life Society, founded in 1808, bought Norwich Union in 1925. The society is still based in Norwich in England's East Anglia region, where among other buildings it has an imposing marble-pillored Victorian-style head office built in 1906.
Norwich Union now has around 40 million pounds ($63 million) of funds under management and had worldwide gross premium income of 4.7 billion in 1995.
Aside from life and general insurance, it has in recent years established a significant presence in healthcare insurance in Britain, with over 470,000 customers and a seven percent market share.
It has operations overseas, notably in Ireland, France, Spain, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, which together provided about 28 percent ot the group's 1995 premium income.

Norwich Union has more than five million customers worldwide, of whom approximately three million have life insurance or pensions policies which make them members of the society and eligible for shares under the flotation.

Gross premium income from life insurance was 2.86 billion pounds in 1995, with gross premium income from general insurance of 1.82 billion. It made an operating profit from general insurance of 111 million pounds in the year.
This year, the group has launched Norwich Union Direct, offering motor and household insurance over the telephone. ($1=.6385 Pound)
